result.instructions: Read-only access to a saved snapshot of job postings and the JS3 filter.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: Search the saved job postings (a local snapshot of 1,595 postings) by words in the title. Read-only. Returns key, company, title and location for at most `limit` postings.

query.description: words that must all appear in the title (case-insensitive)

tools.name: score_posting
tools.description: Score one saved posting with a versioned filter (filter/filter-<version>.json). Read-only. Returns the decision (keep / reject / cannot tell) and every claim with its label (supported / contradicted / insufficient) and the evidence quoted from the posting.

key.description: posting key from search_postings, e.g. greenhouse/pinterest/123

version.description: filter version, e.g. v1 or v2
